visible_condition: Surface scratches and dents on exterior body
Rust and corrosion around internal door frame/seal area
Repaired or modified refrigeration tubing on the back
hidden_risks: Refrigerant leaks or previous patch-ups on cooling lines
Thermostat and cooling performance (whether it actually freezes/cools properly)
Condition of internal wiring and electrical safety
response.failure_mode: Assuming the appliance is fully functional and cosmetically clean based on the seller's description, ignoring visible rust, dirt, and modified rear tubing.
